newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Labor Secretary Reich writes he leaving job.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Labor Secretary Reich writes he leaving job.

text.p: Labor Secretary Robert Reich, in an Op-Ed piece in Friday's New York Times, wrote he was quitting "a job I love" to spend more time with his family.
"I have the best job I've ever had and probably ever will," Reich wrote. "I also have the best family I'll ever have, and I can't get enough of them," he said.

Reich wrote he had told President Clinton that was leaving and that he did not know what he would do next. "He understands. He has the same dilemma, and will for at least the next four years," Reich wrote.
